description: Read ARC's agent commerce adoption counts, category and commerce platform rates from saved HTTP checks, including Checkout WebMCP among measured Shopify checkouts, with unknown and not checked separate; shopper approval required. Curated sample, not all e-commerce. snapshotUcpByPlatform adds UCP profile present, valid and checkout-link counts per platform from each dated open snapshot, each with its denominator. No store requests or model calls.
name: agent_commerce_adoption
